raw.details:
Overview:

AZINHACK ’26 is a 24-hour flagship hackathon organized by IoSC (Intel oneAPI Student Club), GGSIPU East Delhi Campus, bringing together developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers for an intensive 24-hour hackathon experience spread across two days.

Hosted at the University School of Automation and Robotics (USAR), GGSIPU East Delhi Campus, the hackathon gives participants the opportunity to turn ideas into working products, collaborate with other builders, interact with mentors, and present their solutions before an expert jury.

Participants will move through ideation, development, mentorship checkpoints, technical screening, submission, and final demonstrations over the course of the hackathon. Day 1 will run until 7 PM, after which teams will be shortlisted based on the evaluation rounds. Selected teams will return on Day 2 for the final judging and project demonstrations.

Join the WhatsApp Group: Link
Signup on given TinyFish link to claim 13$ free credits : Link

Venue & Dates:

  • USAR, GGSIPU East Delhi Campus, Delhi
  • 21–22 October 2026

Open Innovation Track:

AZINHACK ’26 follows an Open Innovation format, allowing teams to identify a problem of their choice and build a solution around it using any relevant technology stack, domain, or approach.

The only mandatory requirement is that TinyFish must be meaningfully incorporated into the project. Teams are free to decide how TinyFish fits into their product or architecture, but the integration should be functional and relevant to the use case, and teams should be prepared to explain or demonstrate its use during evaluation.

TinyFish × AZINHACK ’26:

We are excited to have TinyFish supporting AZINHACK ’26.

TinyFish provides infrastructure for building AI applications and agents that can interact with the live web, enabling developers to create systems that can retrieve information, understand webpages, and perform actions across websites.

Participants can explore TinyFish capabilities such as:

  • Search API — Retrieve fresh information from the live web
  • Fetch API — Extract structured and AI-ready content from webpages
  • Web Agent — Execute goal-driven, multi-step tasks on websites
  • Browser Infrastructure — Control cloud browsers through tools such as Playwright and CDP

Teams building AI agents, research tools, automation systems, data products, or other web-connected applications are encouraged to explore TinyFish as part of their projects.

What to Expect:

  • 24-hour hackathon format spread across two days
  • Day 1 build and evaluation rounds, followed by Day 2 finals for shortlisted teams
  • Open-ended problem solving and product building
  • Mentor and progress-evaluation rounds
  • Technical and originality screening
  • Final project demonstrations before a jury
  • Industry and community networking
  • ₹1,00,000+ prize pool
  • Sponsor goodies, merchandise, and opportunities
  • Hands-on exposure to emerging developer technologies

The hackathon is designed to provide a structured platform for participants to build, experiment, collaborate, and demonstrate skills beyond the classroom.

Come with an idea or find one worth solving.

24 hours. Two days. Ship something real.
